## What and why

## Kind

- [ ] Editorial (wording, examples, no change in meaning)
- [ ] Erratum (the text, vectors or implementations disagreed)
- [ ] Substantive (changes what conforms; follows a discussion)
- [ ] Code, site or tooling only

## For changes to normative behaviour

- [ ] `SPEC.md` changed, with an entry in Appendix D
- [ ] `tools/oracle.py` changed and `vectors/t32-vectors.json` regenerated
- [ ] Rust crate and TypeScript port updated; `cargo test --all-features` and `npm test` pass
